Category.description: Fault category; drives the failure-analysis breakdown (spec §10.2, §11.2).
Category.title: Category

TaskEnv.description: How the per-task sandbox image is built (spec §9.3).

python.description: Python minor version of the sandbox image, e.g. '3.11'.
python.title: Python

install.description: Shell command run once at image build time, from the repository root, with network access. Must install the project and its test dependencies.
install.title: Install

test_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit for a single test run inside the sandbox.
test_timeout_seconds.title: Test Timeout Seconds

TaskEnv.title: TaskEnv

description: One RepoPilot-Bench task (spec §10.3, extended for deterministic validation).

id.description: Unique task id, lower_snake_case; the task file must be named '<id>.json'.
id.title: Id

repo.description: Git URL (or absolute local path) of the repository to clone.
repo.title: Repo

base_commit.description: Full 40-character commit SHA the sandbox checks out. Short SHAs are rejected.
base_commit.title: Base Commit

source.description: 'real' (bug present at base_commit) or 'mutation' (bug injected by bug_patch).

description.description: The natural-language bug report shown to the agent. Must not leak the fix.
description.title: Description

bug_patch.description: Mutation tasks only: unified diff applied to the clean base_commit at image build time to inject the bug. Must be absent for 'real' tasks.
bug_patch.title: Bug Patch

gold_patch.description: Reference fix as a unified diff. Used by the 'gold' oracle solver to validate the harness and by failure analysis; never shown to the agent.
gold_patch.title: Gold Patch

hidden_test_patch.description: Unified diff adding/changing regression tests, applied only at evaluation time so the agent cannot read the hidden tests from the repository.
hidden_test_patch.title: Hidden Test Patch

fail_to_pass.description: pytest node ids that fail before the fix and must pass after it.
fail_to_pass.title: Fail To Pass

pass_to_pass.description: pytest node ids that pass before the fix and must still pass (regression guard).
pass_to_pass.title: Pass To Pass

test_command.description: Base pytest command run from the repository root, e.g. 'pytest tests/test_retry.py'. The harness appends its own --junitxml flag.
test_command.title: Test Command

gold_files.description: Repository-relative files the fix must touch; the localization target (Recall@k).
gold_files.title: Gold Files

title: RepoPilot-Bench task
